create_fasttext_filter: create a FastTextClassifierFilter to keep documents matching specific label scores above a threshold
build_fasttext_remove_filter: build a FastTextClassifierFilter that removes documents containing labels exceeding a configured score threshold
test_fasttext_filter_mode: test the FastTextClassifierFilter with paragraph-level and sentence-level filtering modes
run_fasttext_annotate: run the FastTextClassifierFilter to annotate documents with label scores saved in metadata
review_fasttext_model_validation: review the FastTextClassifierFilter model property that validates labels against available model labels
